issues.description: Script uses GM_xmlhttpRequest to communicate with ffscouter.com, a third-party server. Potential for user data transmission exists, but only ffscouter.com is targeted and no evidence of cookie/page content transmission found in the visible code.
issues.recommendation: Review all transmitted payloads to ensure no sensitive user data or cookies are sent. Limit data sent to only what is necessary for functionality.

issues.description: Script requests GM_xmlhttpRequest permission, which is necessary for API calls but is a high privilege. No evidence of unused high privilege grants.
issues.recommendation: Ensure only necessary permissions are requested. Remove unused grants if possible.

issues.description: Script uses @connect ffscouter.com, which is a third-party domain. Supply chain risk is present if the server is compromised.
issues.recommendation: Ensure ffscouter.com is trustworthy and monitor for supply chain risks.

summary: FF Scouter V2 communicates with a third-party server (ffscouter.com) using GM_xmlhttpRequest, which is necessary for its functionality. No evidence of privacy-invasive data collection, code obfuscation, or DOM XSS risks in the visible code. Supply chain risk exists due to reliance on an external API. Permissions requested are appropriate for the script's purpose. Overall, the script is reasonably safe but should be monitored for supply chain and data transmission risks.
